findings.message: Schema validation failed; XML does not comply with UBL 2.1 standards in line with ZATCA specifications. ERROR: org.xml.sax.SAXParseException; lineNumber: 135; columnNumber: 30; cvc-complex-type.2.4.b: The content of element 'ns2:LegalMonetaryTotal' is not complete. One of '{"urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonBasicComponents-2":PayableAmount}' is expected.
[BR-15]-An Invoice shall have the Amount due for payment (BT-115).
[BR-CO-16]-Amount due for payment (BT-115) = Invoice total amount with VAT (BT-112) -Pre-Paid amount (BT-113) + Rounding amount (BT-114).
[BR-KSA-19]-Each Document level charge (BG-21) shall have a code for the reason for document level charge (BT-105).
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
[BR-KSA-15]-The tax invoice ((invoice type code (BT-30) = 388) and (invoice transaction code (KSA-2) has "01" as first 2 digits)) must contain the supply date (KSA-5).
